excerpt: The gold-standard model of MBSR is an 8-week course involving 20 to 26 hours of formal meditation training during eight weekly group classes of 1.5 to 2.5 hours, one all-day 6-hour class, and home practice of about 45 minutes per day, 6 days per week; brief adaptations may involve as few as four 20-minute sessions.
overview: This protocol description makes the intervention-heterogeneity problem auditable. When studies label both intensive MBSR and very brief training as mindfulness-based, pooled conclusions can obscure dose, content, and delivery differences that matter for efficacy and safety.
title: MBSR Intervention Dose
